## Extracts from SECI tender where Rs. 2.00 tariff was discovered

*సెకీ
సూర్య సదేవ SUN FOR EVER*
Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited
(A Government of India Enterprise)
1. 0 Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (hereinafter called "SECI") is a Government of
2. India Enterprise under the administrative control of the Ministry of New & Renewable
3. Energy (MNRE). One of the main objectives of the Company is to assist the Ministry and
4. function as the implementing and facilitating arm of the National Solar Mission (NSM) for
5. development, promotion and commercialization of solar energy technologies in the country.
7. 0 Ministry of Power (MoP) has issued "Guidelines for Tariff Based Competitive Bidding
8. Process for Procurement of Power from Grid Connected Solar PV Power Projects" vide
9. Gazette Resolution dated 03.08.2017. These Guidelines have been issued under the
10. provisions of Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003 for long term procurement of electricity
11. by the 'Producers', from grid-connected Solar PV Power Projects, having size of 5 MW and
12. above, through competitive bidding. This RIS document has been prepared in line with the
13. above Guidelines issued by MoP dated 03.08.2017, including subsequent amendments
14. and clarifications.
16. 0 As part of the Government of India's target to achieve a cumulative capacity of 100 GW
17. Solar PV installation by the year 2022, SECI wishes to invite proposals for setting up of
18. grid connected Solar PV projects in the State of Rajasthan on "Build Own Operate" (B-O-
19. O) basis for an aggregate capacity of 1070 MW. SECI shall enter into a Power Purchase
20. Agreement (PPA) with the successful Bidder selected based on this RIS for purchase of
21. Solar Power for a period of 25 years based on the terms, conditions and provisions of the
22. RIS.
24. 0 Power procured by SECI from the above Project has been provisioned to be sold to the
25. State Buying Entity, i.e. Rajasthan Urja Vikas Nigam Limited (RUVNL), which shall be the
26. Buying Entity under this RIS. SECI shall be an intermediary nodal agency for procurement
27. of power generated by the SPD and sale of such power to RUVNL entirely on back to back
28. basis based on due performance by the SPD as well as the Buying entity.
